lines.sentence: As you’re warming you’re packing up from having camped in the woods last night, the woods give way to a woman and a younger man. They’re disheveled and breathing hard, but their eyes light up upon seeing you.

Ah! Traveller, I’d humbly ask for your assistance. You see, my apprentice and I recently defected from our coven when we discovered they were meddling with restricted magic. It was dangerous! They attempted to get rid of us for our protest. We humbly ask your help to stop them from chasing us and from using this forbidden magic.

choices.choiceText: I’m sure it must have been hard, but you did the right thing, and if what you are saying is true, then I'll help you both.
This matter is a bit delicate; if I step into these things, they could get worse. Find somewhere to lay low and let things handle themselves.

lines.sentence: I figured we would be running for the rest of our lives, but thanks to you, we won't have to.
I understand, come on, Apprentice, may our pursuers lose chase before our legs give out.
